notes.title: Dorky Fork will become free to play this Summer!
notes.notes:
Dear Dorky Fork players, 

Thank you for playing the game. Today I am excited to announce that Dorky Fork will become a free to play game forever later this Summer.

I am very grateful for people who purchased Dorky Fork, your support means everything to me! 


Now I think is time for more people to experience the game. 


Once again I want to thank everybody who bought my first game that is Dorky Fork, I will forever cherish this.


Sincerely,
Aaron Moon
